subject: GGIR for Lower back L5 Sensor

messages.author: c78b162778912ac6
messages.subject: GGIR for Lower back L5 Sensor
parts:
Hi, I am new to GGIR package and i know its for the wrist sensor. Is there anyone who optimized this for the lower back L5 sensors? Or any guidance to use this package for lowerback L5 senosr will be much appreciated. 

Thanks in advance, 
Rana

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: GGIR for Lower back L5 Sensor
parts:
Hi Rana,

GGIR is not developed specifically for a body attachment site, it can be used in any site. What do you want optimized for lower back? If you're looking for cut-points, I would say you can use the hip-based cut-points by Hildebrand et al. (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/27878845, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/24887173).

Best,
Jairo
